result:
I've made the code, test and guide repairs, but I could not run the Compose drill: this sandbox can't reach a Docker daemon. So F-DG7-1072 and F-DG7-1082 are fixed in code and in the guide, but nothing has shown them working in Compose yet. All five findings stay open for the reviewers.

**The drill is BLOCKED.** `docker info` was refused permission on `/var/run/docker.sock`, and `ensure-docker.sh` exited 3 because `/run` is read-only here. A daemon of my own wouldn't have the `mth-app:local` and `postgres:18` images, and the sandbox can't map uid 10001. I didn't try to get around the sandbox. On a host with Docker, someone needs to run this as root:
`MTH_SECRETS_DIR=<dir> MTH_BACKUP_ROOT=<owner-only dir> deploy/scripts/drill/compose-backup-drill.sh --log <file>`

**F-DG7-1061/1071/1081 (empty `config.files`, stray `cat` error):**
- `backup.sh` now keeps the `config/` listing in the set's `.backup-state/`, on the shared backup root. Before, it was in a temporary directory that was deleted when the first step ended, so the finish step found nothing.
- The finish step checks the listing still matches `config/` and its recorded hash, then writes it into the manifest. It fails the set if the listing is missing or `config/` changed between steps.
- The split-phase test (T-E11) now fails on any output to stderr and on an empty `config.files`. A new test, T-E11b, covers the two refusals.

**F-DG7-1072/1082 (restored evidence the API can't read, drill with no data):**
- `restore.sh` now hands the restored evidence to the API's account and sets directories to `0700` and files to `0600`. That account defaults to the owner of the empty target evidence root, which is uid 10001 in Compose, and a new `--evidence-owner <uid>:<gid>` option can set it. The restore check R7 fails on any other owner or loose permission.
- The drill no longer runs its own `chown`. It now uploads 2 synthetic evidence files through a one-off dev-login API in the app image, running as uid 10001, and queues 1 synthetic job. It fails if the copy-out moves fewer than 2 files, if the finish step prints an error or writes an empty `config.files`, or if the restored files don't match the source in owner, mode, count and hashes when read as uid 10001.
- I also fixed C7 and C10, which were silently ignoring some failures.
- `backup-restore.md` §3.2, §5, §7, §8, §10 and the Arabic summary are updated. §8 now says the earlier orchestrator run moved 0 evidence objects and 0 jobs.

**Checks run** (logs in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG7/T-DG7-DO-D14-evidence/`):

| Check | Exit | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| backup-restore tests on disposable PostgreSQL | 0 | 21 pass, 1 skipped |
| Compose layout tests (vitest) | 0 | 14 pass |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm openapi:lint` | 0 | pass |
| `pnpm test` | 0 | 3056, 2199 and 259 tests pass |
| Contract test on disposable PostgreSQL | 0 | 111 pass |
| Repository-wide prettier | 0 | pass |
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG6` | 0 | PASS |

**What is still untested:**
- The skipped test is T-E14c: restore as root handing the evidence to uid 10001. The sandbox can't `chown` to uid 10001, so the only ownership case that ran here is restoring as the store's own account.
- The drill's dev-login API step has never been run against the app image.
- The R7 report gained three fields (`owner`, `otherOwner`, `groupOrOtherBits`), and ADR-0066 §7 needs an architect's amendment to record the new ownership rule.
- The ADR-0066 file shows as modified in the worktree because of the concurrent architect task (SA-ADR73), not me.

Handback: `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG7/T-DG7-DO-D14-devops-engineer.md`
